rules.statement: Section 12A(1)(d) of the Rent Restriction Act, as amended by Act 12 of 1966, supersedes any rights arising on a tenancy agreement in regard to notice when there is wanton destruction or damage.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion once section 12A (1) (d) applies it supersedes the rights in regard to notice arising on a tenancy agreement."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 12A(1)(d) of the Rent Restriction Act, as amended by Act 12 of 1966.
